is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on four species from the Anopheles (An.) gambiae complex: An. gambiae sensu stricto, An. coluzzii, An. arabiensis and An. melas (Page 1, Abstract).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping of Vgsc L995F (L1014F), Vgsc N1570Y (N1575Y), Vgsc I1527T (I1532T), Vgsc V402L (V410L), Ace-1 G280S (G119S), and Rdl A296G (A282) (Page 3, Results; Page 5, Figure 2).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Genotype frequencies and percentages are provided for several markers. For example, L995F was detected in Guinea (67% R/R; 33% R/S) and Ivory Coast (57% R/R; 36% R/S). Sample sizes (N) for each species and country are provided in Table 1 (Page 3).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from field sites in Guinea (Maferinyah), Ivory Coast (Aboudé), Cabo Verde (Praia), and Ghana (Dogo) (Page 7, Mosquito sampling).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study describing and validating a new high-throughput amplicon sequencing method for mosquito surveillance (Page 1).

sub_country_location.evidence: Specific collection sites are named, including Aboudé (Ivory Coast), Maferinyah (Guinea), Praia (Cabo Verde), and Dogo (Ghana) (Page 7).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collection years are specified for each country: Guinea (2017-2018), Ivory Coast (2019), Cabo Verde (2017), and Ghana (2015) (Page 7, Table 1).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The paper explicitly states that 'Specimens were captured as part of ongoing studies in Guinea (n=24; years 2017–2018)42,48, Ivory Coast (n=46; 2019)47, Cabo Verde (n=24; 2017) and Ghana (n=2; 2015)50' (Page 7). These references (Collins et al. 2019, Stica et al. 2019, Meiwald et al. 2020, Orsborne et al. 2019) likely contain overlapping genotype data for these specific samples.

supplement.evidence: Supplementary Table 5 is cited as containing the detailed genotype data for the insecticide resistance markers across the different sites and species (Page 3).

assessment.summary: The study presents a high-throughput amplicon sequencing method for species identification and insecticide resistance marker genotyping in the Anopheles gambiae complex. It reports genotype frequencies for Vgsc (L995F, N1570Y, I1527T, V402L), Ace-1 (G280S), and Rdl (A296G) in field populations from Guinea, Ivory Coast, Cabo Verde, and Ghana.
